description: Implementation of WebSocketDeflateStream class handling WebSocket frame compression and decompression with deflate algorithm, including reading, writing, inflating, deflating, and frame management.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frame compression and decompression using deflate, managing frame reading, writing, and state transitions.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames and inflates compressed frames if necessary.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Deflates frames and writes them to the underlying stream.

methods.name: GetSubProtocol
methods.description: Returns the subprotocol used by the stream.

methods.name: GetExtensions
methods.description: Returns the extensions used by the stream.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a read operation, handling inflating frames.

methods.name: OnMessageStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a new message, predicting whether to deflate.

methods.name: AppendCompressedFrame
methods.description: Creates a compressed frame from deflater output.

methods.name: AppendPossiblyCompressedMessage
methods.description: Creates a compressed frame for a message if compression is effective.

methods.name: InflateAndReadIfNecessary
methods.description: Inflates frames and reads more if needed.
